title: Integers 1 to 100 divisible by 2, 3 or 5
caption: Adding 50 + 33 + 20 counts overlaps twice, so subtract 16 + 10 + 6 and add back 3: 74. The remaining 26 numbers are divisible by none of 2, 3, 5.
alt: Three overlapping circles for multiples of 2, 3 and 5 among 1 to 100, with region counts; 74 numbers lie inside at least one circle and 26 outside.
description: Each circle holds the multiples of 2, 3 or 5.
Overlaps hold multiples of 6, 10, 15 and the centre multiples of 30.
Inclusion–exclusion gives 74; 26 lie outside all three.
